description: This Java source file defines the class 'ThingModifyResponseSignalMapper', which extends 'AbstractModifySignalMapper' and implements 'ResponseSignalMapper'. It maps responses related to 'ThingModify' commands to signals, validating responses, building topic paths, and enhancing payloads accordingly.

classes.name: ThingModifyResponseSignalMapper
classes.description: A class that maps 'ThingModify' command responses to signals, validating responses, constructing topic paths, and enhancing payloads.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the command response by checking its class name suffix. Throws an exception if the response name does not end with 'response'.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new TopicPathBuilder for the given command to build the appropriate topic path.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Enhances the PayloadBuilder with the status code and, if present, the entity from the command response.
